Grab your Google Analytics **Measurement ID** (looks like `G‑XXXXXXXXXX`). 2. Go to Vercel → Your project → Settings → Environment Variables. - Add a new variable: **Key** `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID`, **Value** `G‑XXXXXXXXXX`, **Environment** `Production` (and optionally `Preview` if you want to see analytics there). 3. In your local repo, run `npx npm i @vercel/analytics`. 4. Replace the content of `pages/_app.js` with the snippet above (if you already have a custom `_app.js`, just add the `` component inside the render). 5. Commit, push, and Vercel will rebuild your site. 6. Visit the site and open the browser console – you should see a message from the analytics package. 7. Open your GA account, go to Realtime → see the page view. That’s it! Your site will now be tracking visitors with Google Analytics, and you’ve kept everything safe and tidy.
